band_fixed.name: Band → Color
band_fixed.desc: Bass=warm red/orange, mids=green, treble=blue, blended by which is loudest.

dominant_band.name: Dominant Band
dominant_band.desc: Hue smoothly follows whichever of bass/mid/treble currently dominates.

weighted_blend.name: Spectral Blend
weighted_blend.desc: Continuous hue sweep driven by the overall tonal balance, not fixed anchors.

vu_meter.name: VU Meter
vu_meter.desc: Fixed hue, brightness only — a direct volume meter.

auto_rotate_hue.name: Auto-Rotate
auto_rotate_hue.desc: Hue slowly cycles on its own; brightness/beats still track the audio.

monochrome_pulse.name: Monochrome Pulse
monochrome_pulse.desc: One color of your choice that pulses brighter with the beat.

strobe_on_drop.name: Strobe on Drop
strobe_on_drop.desc: Dim warm baseline, full white flash only on hard bass hits.

palette_cycle.name: Palette Cycle
palette_cycle.desc: Steps through the built-in color presets, advancing on each detected beat.

spectrum_gradient.name: Spectrum Gradient
spectrum_gradient.desc: Continuous hue gradient across N bands (set below) — much finer-grained than the 3-anchor Band → Color mode.

band_flash_overlay.name: Band Flash Overlay
band_flash_overlay.desc: Ambient N-band gradient base color, with brief accent flashes whenever any individual band spikes.

stereo_split.name: Stereo Split
stereo_split.desc: Hue leans left/right-anchor based on which stereo channel is louder (needs a 2-channel input device).

breathing_silence.name: Breathing Silence
breathing_silence.desc: Slow ambient breathing brightness during quiet passages instead of going flat/dark; wakes up smoothly when audio returns.

harmonic_pairs.name: Harmonic Pairs
harmonic_pairs.desc: Finds the two most energetic non-adjacent bands each frame and blends between two complementary (180°-apart) hues based on which one dominates; more bands (below) sharpen the pairing.

kick_snare_split.name: Kick/Snare Split
kick_snare_split.desc: Bass drives brightness like a kick drum while a separate mid-band accent shifts the hue like a layered snare/hihat.

energy_contour.name: Energy Contour
energy_contour.desc: Hue locked to your chosen color; only saturation/brightness track a smoothed energy envelope for a slow-moving contour instead of a punchy pulse.

bass_only_pulse.name: Bass-Only Pulse
bass_only_pulse.desc: Brightness-only pulse driven purely by the bass band's share of the mix — hue never moves.

mirror_mode.name: Mirror Mode
mirror_mode.desc: Hue mirrors around a fixed center point as the treble/bass balance shifts, while brightness breathes independently — a breathing color effect.

random_walk_hue.name: Random Walk Hue
random_walk_hue.desc: Hue takes small bounded random steps instead of rotating at a fixed rate — feels organic rather than mechanical.

silence_flash_recover.name: Silence Flash Recover
silence_flash_recover.desc: Dims through any quiet passage, then fires one bright white flash the instant audio resumes after a long pause.

crescendo_ramp.name: Crescendo Ramp
crescendo_ramp.desc: Detects a sustained rise in energy over a couple of seconds and ramps brightness/saturation up ahead of the peak, not just when it's already loud.
